    Ray products #

    Lemma 3.6 (projective-rays.tex): "Every unit of R_y is a nonzero scalar times 1 + n with n ∈ rad R_y. Thus changing representatives replaces their product, up to a nonzero scalar and endpoint units, by fh + fnh. The subbimodule M(f,h) is unchanged. If fh ∉ M(f,h), the chain property forces M(f,h) ⊊ U(fh) […] so M(f,h) ⊆ R(fh). Thus the changed product remains in U(fh) ∖ R(fh), is nonzero and has ray [fh]. If fh ∈ M(f,h), the changed product is still in M(f,h)."
